carbon_files.description: Carbon pretraining source-mix windows from the pinned corpus revision for the correction-control smoke run

clinvar.description: Deterministic line-capped prefix of archived 2026-04-15 ClinVar GRCh38 SNVs with chromosome 22 held out

gnomad.description: Generation-pinned gnomAD v4.1 exome chr22 PASS common SNV prefix packaged for input-integrity coverage

intended_use: A 50-step clean-machine smoke run of the corrected L2-normalized Phase-1 training and artifact pipeline.
leakage_checks: No training split may share comparable variant keys with held-out ClinVar evaluation rows.
Split record counts and comparable-key overlaps are recomputed from staged files before upload.
license: Apache-2.0 for GenoLeWM package metadata; upstream data licenses and terms apply to source records.
limitations: This snapshot is a bounded pipeline smoke artifact, not a benchmark dataset or model-quality result.
The 50-step run does not establish convergence, deterministic reproducibility, variant-effect accuracy, rollout fidelity, planning quality, or clinical utility.
The ClinVar and gnomAD inputs are deterministic 60000-line prefixes of immutable upstream objects.

The active contexts are unplaced Carbon corpus windows, so absolute gnomAD and ClinVar variants cannot be mapped onto them; the smoke run uses explicit synthetic SNV fallbacks and makes no real-variant training claim.
preprocessing: Stage 512 Carbon source-mix windows from the pinned Hugging Face corpus revision.
Verify immutable upstream identities before filtering or packaging.
Filter the generation-pinned gnomAD prefix to PASS common SNVs for packaged-input integrity coverage.
Hold chromosome 22 out of the archived ClinVar evaluation rows.

sources.name: Carbon pretraining corpus
sources.notes: Only the pinned corpus commit is streamed; the training encoder is mounted separately at its pinned revision.

sources.name: gnomAD
sources.notes: The generation query pins the exact v4.1 exome chr22 object; the job packages the first 60000 decompressed lines.

sources.name: ClinVar
sources.notes: The job verifies the dated archive against its official MD5, holds chromosome 22 out, and packages the first 60000 remaining lines.

split_policy: Carbon and packaged gnomAD training material excludes any comparable variant keys present in the held-out ClinVar evaluation split.

eval_clinvar.description: archived ClinVar SNV labels outside chromosome 22 for pipeline-integrity checks

train_carbon.description: pinned Carbon source-mix windows for the bounded smoke run

train_gnomad_common.description: generation-pinned gnomAD common SNVs retained for package-integrity coverage
